#!/usr/bin/perl
use strict;
use warnings;
package Robot;
sub new { my ($class, %args) = @_; my $self = { pos => [0, 0], %args }; return bless $self, $class; }
sub move {
    my ($self, $cmds) = @_;
    for my $c (split //, $cmds) {
        if ($c eq 'A') { $self->{pos}[1]++ }
        elsif ($c =~ /^[LR]$/) { next }
        else { die "bad command $c\n" }
    }
    return $self;
}
my %h = (a => 1, b => [1, 2]);
my @sorted = sort { $a <=> $b } map { $_ * 2 } grep { $_ } @{ $h{b} };
print "@sorted\n" unless !@sorted;
1;
